description.value:
You use magic energy to quickly run a number of scripts in parallel that instruct a construct's inner mechanisms to repair themselves with the excess magic power. When you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain it on subsequent rounds, either one construct of your choice in range regains 1d8 Hit Points or two constructs of your choice in range each regain 1d4 Hit Points.

Heightened (+1) The number of Hit Points regained increases by 1d8 if you target one construct or by 1d4 if you target two constructs.
